versions.changelog:
Initial release of formpass-forms: Connect web forms to the FormPass network for AI agent access.

- Integrate any React, HTML, or WordPress form with FormPass for agent discovery and submissions.
- Add discovery meta tags and submit relay to enable verified AI agent access.
- Supports WordPress (Gravity Forms and Contact Form 7) via plugin.
- Provides API examples for schema access and submission testing.
- Free plan requires "Powered by FormPass" branding; Pro tier available.
- Includes links to full documentation and agent integration guides.
